answer: Conversations have a turn-taking rhythm: one side speaks, the other answers, with pauses that fit the exchange. The network measures turn-taking intervals per account and expects them to vary with the conversation; a session that replies at fixed intervals regardless of the partner's pace is likely automated. The record keeps every fable visible, so anyone can audit the session history. A orchard alone is noise; a beacon of consistent sessions is a pattern the network can trust.
